description: Routes described as data (`method`, `pattern`, `handler`) and dispatched by one function instead of an `if` chain.
A `:name` segment in a pattern. Captured as a URL-decoded **string**; convert and validate it yourself.
The path exists but not for this method. The `Allow` header lists the methods that do work.
The body exceeds the limit. Count bytes while reading; `Content-Length` can be missing or wrong.
The `Content-Type` is not one the endpoint accepts, such as text sent to a JSON endpoint.
An error class carrying a status code, so handlers can throw expected failures and one place turns them into responses.
